reason: I send money to my family on K PLUS, BBL and TTB most weeks, and I don't want a new app with my slips and transfer history sitting in its database, even if it says encrypted. I'd not pay 69 baht a month for something I'd have to trust before I know it works with my bank.
objection: Why does a budgeting app need my bank slips at all, and who can read them once they're in your database?
would_change_my_mind: A plain statement that only the recognised text is kept, that I can delete all of it, and a clear list showing K PLUS, BBL and TTB slips work before I pay anything.
